description: Four validation schemes for a ten-bar-horizon model, each letting information cross the train/test boundary a different way.

expected.note: KFold with shuffle=True scatters future bars into every training fold.
train_test_split shuffles by default, interleaving test rows with their own neighbours.
TimeSeriesSplit with no gap and no embargo, against a ten-bar label.
gap=2 against a ten-bar horizon leaves eight overlapping bars unpurged.
